title: 第2327章 一群老魔帝内心的对比第2326章 叭叭叭地找人分享他的体验和快乐
content_zh:
魔帝宫
郑鹏分身被囚禁
金魔帝没有施暴，没有虐待，就是囚禁。
侍卫长有些看不懂，终于在囚禁郑鹏分身三个月后，他忍不住询问。
“魔帝大人，被您亲自抓回来的人类武者，满三个月了，需不需要送点物资进去？”
“不需要，这个人类武者体内神力雄浑，应该用不着！”
金魔帝一脸冷漠，不以为然。魔帝宫内是金魔帝大人的本尊，和已经在人族地界风家和风家小公主风美玲鬼混的金魔帝分身金玉郎不同，一股上位者独有的威仪，不怒自威。
侍卫长本能的神情一滞，愣住了好久，半晌回过神，正欲退走，胡地摇了摇头，似乎想起了什么，随即开口。
“不过有一点属下要提醒魔帝大人，连续一个月的抽灵，而且开启的是最强状态，就是高级魔皇也奄奄一息。”
侍卫长说的抽空，堪比魔族针对人族设置的一种刑法。人族修炼吸收灵气，抽灵就是利用空间阵法，将人体内的灵力抽取，轻者跌落武道境界，重者武道境界不断下降直到消失殆尽，成为废人，莫说逃跑，就是放任不管，受刑者也形同一堆烂肉。
金魔帝为何如此对待郑鹏分身？好不容易将其抓进魔界，又折腾成废人，岂不是费力不讨好？
这也是侍卫长百思不得其解的事情，若是有什么深仇大恨，要折磨人泄恨，或许理解，但也用不着带到魔帝宫密室，大费周章，大可以在进入魔界后就可以肆意泄愤，以魔帝的手段，要杀人取乐，折磨人报复，手段不下千百种。
“若真像你说的那样，可以暂停抽灵大阵三日。”
意思很明了，三日过后继续抽灵。
侍卫长疑惑未消，但魔帝大人不再多言，只好俯首听命，退出宫殿，朝密室走去。
“这样不停地抽有啥意思？”
抽取的人族灵力，对魔族之人毫无用处。抽灵大阵不同于吞噬功法，是毁灭之力，对人族武者是毁灭性的伤害。抽取的灵力并没有转化成能量储存，而是毁灭殆尽。折磨人的同时，并没有得到好处。
和侍卫长一样的魔人有很多。很多魔人觉得与其这样折腾，不如将其打上魔印，将其收为魔奴，任意驱使，何乐而不为？
想法有，但都藏在心里，不敢说出来。魔帝大人要做什么，岂是一帮下属可以随意置喙？
魔稽山上一群老魔帝关注着金魔帝的魔帝宫。

王姓老魔帝因为孙儿到人族地界走一遭，还没有尽兴，就败在以人族少年分身手上，还被人族大佬吼一嗓子就成了浑身伤痕累累，魔气几乎消失殆尽的惨状。
“同为魔帝，小金就比小王强了不少！”
“至少运气强很多！”
其实很多老魔帝心里跟明镜似的，金魔帝进入人族地界，取得风家家主夫妇认可之前，是刻意避开人族隐世家族圈的真正大佬。
“小王魔帝是大喇喇地在人族地界与人交手，运气差到极点，刚交手就踢到了铁板。”
content_en:
Devil's Palace
Zheng Peng's clone was imprisoned
The Golden Demon Emperor did not commit violence or torture, he was just imprisoned.
The captain of the guard was a little confused. Finally, after imprisoning Zheng Peng's clone for three months, he couldn't help but ask.
"Lord Demon Emperor, the human warrior who was captured by you personally has been over three months old. Do you need to send some supplies in?"
"No need, this human warrior has powerful divine power in his body, so he shouldn't need it!"
The Golden Demon Emperor looked cold and disapproving. In the Demon Emperor's Palace is the true form of the Golden Demon Emperor. Unlike Jin Yulang, the clone of the Golden Demon Emperor who has been fooling around with Feng Meiling, the little princess of the Feng family, in the human realm, he has the unique majesty of a superior person. He is not angry and has authority.
The captain of the guard's expression instinctively froze, and he was stunned for a long time. After a while, he came to his senses and was about to retreat. He shook his head Hu Di, as if he remembered something, and then spoke.
"But one thing I would like to remind you, Lord Demon Emperor, is that even the high-level Demon Emperor is dying after a month of continuous seizures and in the strongest state."
The captain of the guard said that he was taking time out, which is comparable to a kind of criminal law set by the demon clan against the human race. The human race practices to absorb spiritual energy. Spirit extraction is the use of space formations to extract the spiritual energy from the human body. In the least case, the martial arts realm will fall. In severe cases, the martial arts realm will continue to decline until it disappears and becomes a useless person. Not to mention running away, even if you let it go, the person who is being tortured will be like a pile of rotten meat.
Why did the Golden Demon Emperor treat Zheng Peng's clone like this? Isn't it a thankless effort to finally capture him into the demon world and then turn him into a useless person?
This is also something that the captain of the guard has always wondered about. If there is any deep hatred and you want to torture people to vent your hatred, you may understand it, but there is no need to take it to the secret room of the Demon Emperor's Palace and spend a lot of time. You can vent your anger wantonly after entering the Demon Realm. With the Demon Emperor's methods, you can kill for fun and torture people for revenge. There are no less than thousands of methods.
"If it's like what you said, we can suspend the spirit extraction formation for three days."
The meaning is very clear. After three days, the seizures will continue.
The captain of the guard was still confused, but the Demon Emperor said no more and had no choice but to bow his head and obey the order, exit the palace and walk towards the secret room.
"What's the point of smoking like this?"
The extracted human spiritual power is of no use to the demons. The spirit-drawing formation is different from the swallowing technique. It is a destructive force and can cause devastating damage to human warriors. The extracted spiritual power was not converted into energy storage, but was completely destroyed. While it tortures people, it does not benefit them at all.
There are many demons like the captain of the guard. Many demons think that instead of going through such trouble, it is better to put a demon seal on them, take them as demon slaves, and drive them at will. Why not?
I have ideas, but I hide them in my heart and dare not say them out. What does the Demon Emperor want to do? Can a bunch of subordinates just say whatever they want?
A group of old Demon Emperors on Moji Mountain are paying attention to the Demon Emperor Palace of the Golden Demon Emperor.
The old demon emperor surnamed Wang was defeated by a clone of a young human race before his grandson visited the realm of the human race. He was also yelled at by a human race boss, leaving him in a miserable state with scars all over his body and almost all the demonic energy gone.
"Both are Demon Emperors, but Xiao Jin is much stronger than Xiao Wang!"
"At least you have better luck!"
In fact, many old demon emperors feel like Ming Jing. Before the Golden Demon Emperor entered the realm of the human race and gained the approval of the Feng family head and his wife, he deliberately avoided being a real big boss in the hidden family circle of the human race.
"The little devil king fought with people in the human realm. His luck was so bad that he hit the wall right after the fight."
